Hi Mikko,

Bioconductor bumped up to 3.1 and I wasn’t able to update the package directly from my personal laptop. Meanwhile, I’ve been using IGV (http://www.broadinstitute.org/igv/) for visualization. Use the code attached to generate whole-genome seg files and then load them into IGV for visualization. I have some codes for generating heatmaps but they are essentially the same as loading the results into IGV, which is very user-friendly.

Let me know if you’ve any further questions.

Cheers,
Yuchao
